title: High School Vocabulary | Narrative Nonfiction
description: High school learners will be introduced to vocabulary words within a variety of memoirs, autobiographies, and nonfiction pieces. Students will read a brief overview about each piece, be presented with the vocabulary words, definitions, synonyms, and antonyms from these novels, and complete vocabulary activities to practice using these words in context.
